Solution 2 is correct. The total number of 5-member subcommittees from 14 people is C(14,5) = 2002. Subtract the all-Republican case C(8,5) = 56 and the all-Democrat case C(6,5) = 6, giving 2002 − 62 = 1940.

Solution 1 omits the 1 Republican, 4 Democrat case, C(8,1)·C(6,4) = 120, so its total is 1820 instead of 1820 + 120 = 1940.

Solution 3 omits the 4 Republican, 1 Democrat case, C(8,4)·C(6,1) = 420, so its total is 1520 instead of 1520 + 420 = 1940.

CHOICE: 2
